wiki.title: Andrew Pruski
wiki.extract: Andrew Christopher Pruski (born November 11, 1978) is an American politician. He is a member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 33A in Anne Arundel County, Maryland. He was previously a member of the Anne Arundel County Council from 2014 to 2022, serving as its chair from 2018 to 2019 and its vice-chair from 2021 to 2022.
